top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises an unbroken, mature discovery chain: human incretin physiology and proglucagon processing (Holst), the biologically active GLP-1(7-36) peptide (Mojsov), and receptor and tissue biology (Drucker). It is confirmed by large independent outcome trials across glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal endpoints. The three-person allocation fits the cap, and a physiology-centred citation that makes no priority claim about the active form limits exposure to the Mojsov/Habener dispute. Leaving out Knudsen is a stated policy line between discovery and development, not a scientific finding. No award is worse than a defensible award for a settled achievement.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; the documented co-authorship with Thomas Perlmann concerns dopamine neuron topics and has no bearing on GLP-1
